scope: Analytics container only. Separate from the 11 npm upstream findings.
method: Read-only Docker inventory with network disabled; OSV package/version queries; official Debian tracker and selected upstream source/advisory cross-checks. No Spark startup or exploit testing.

runtime.py4jNote: Both are shipped through the official PySpark3.5.9 distribution/dependency resolution; neither package/version matched OSV. No individual JAR replacement.

pipVendorExclusions.reason: The vulnerable C/Cython Unpacker is absent. pip vendors only Python fallback files. The upstream fix changes _unpacker.pyx and unpack_template.h.
pip does not vendor the vulnerable setuptools/package_index.py implementation.
pip does not vendor the affected FileList/egg_info implementation. The image is Linux and does not publish source distributions.

reachability.evidence: purge_pending.build_spark selects Iceberg REST catalog; Iceberg HTTPClient uses classic CloseableHttpClient. A malicious catalog response could exercise these response handling flaws. A hostile response was not tested.
reachability.officialParentLimit: Iceberg 1.11.0 still selects httpclient5 5.6.1, below the 5.6.3 fix. No verified parent-only upgrade clears this set.

reachability.evidence: The old Spark JAR remains. The Iceberg reader has a separate relocated aircompressor 2.0.3 copy containing the fix. Reused uncleared output buffers and attacker-crafted Snappy/LZ4 input are required; the old copy was not proven used by the Iceberg deletion path.

Avro 1.7.7 is relocated inside Hadoop client runtime; the configured Iceberg reader has relocated Avro 1.12.1. This job does not configure ZooKeeper quorum peers, Derby LDAP authentication, or Jackson1 polymorphic deserialization. These requirements were not exercised; class presence alone is not exploit proof.
Iceberg HttpClientProperties defaults synchronous AWS clients to Apache HTTP client; its Netty async client is not the selected default. This does not exclude separate Spark Netty usage.

The official Bookworm tracker has no fixed Bookworm version for these matched entries. Some involve absent server components or unused APIs; source-package matching alone does not establish binary or application exposure. Example: zlib CVE-2023-45853 is explicitly ignored because minizip is not built.

requiredChanges: Use iceberg-spark-runtime-4.1_2.13 and matching AWS bundle 1.11.0.
Scala 2.12 is unsupported in Spark4; use Scala2.13. Spark4.1.3 requires Java17 or21 and Python3.10+.
Review ANSI SQL default, table provider selection, partition sizing, timestamp and file-error behavior. Revalidate delete, rewrite, expiry, orphan cleanup and old snapshots.
officialMigrationLimits.remainingRisk: Spark4.1.3 still selects Netty4.2.7.Final and libthrift0.16.0; Iceberg1.11.0 still selects HttpClient5.6.1. A major migration is not a complete advisory fix.

officialMigrationLimits.status: No official Iceberg4.2 runtime is listed in the current Iceberg support matrix; do not pair the existing3.5 runtime with Spark4.2.
No compatible fixed Bookworm package exists in the tracker for these matches. Do not mix Debian distributions or replace individual native/JAR libraries to force a clean count.

coverageLimits: OSV and repository advisories can lag disclosures and may misclassify shaded metadata.

All254 JAR filenames were mapped using Maven metadata, Spark release dependency metadata or verified Maven Central POMs. Native code or hidden embedded libraries without identifiable version metadata are not exhaustively audited.
No attacker-controlled sample, exploit, complete loaded-class trace, production endpoint or network exposure validation was performed.
Debian source matches were cross-checked against the official tracker; per-binary and per-feature reachability remains incomplete.
The host kernel, Docker daemon and deployed production image are outside this container review.
No package patches, dependency overrides, individual JAR replacements, image mutations, tests or deployment were performed by this review.
